channel.title: The Grant Desk - US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: COLA-IMAP 2027-29: Independent Master Artist Projects, USD 10,000 (Los Angeles) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: USD 10,000 per artist (budget dependent). No application fee stated.

The City of Los Angeles Independent Master Artist Project (COLA-IMAP) grant supports established LA artists to create new work, presented publicly by the city.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI): Seed Grants 2026 for humanities-forward AI research in Atlanta (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI), Mellon Foundation funded
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: Up to USD 5,000 per project. In line with Mellon policy, no institutional overhead may be charged. Individuals taking the award outside an institution or employer pay income tax on it. No application fee.

AIAI funds humanities-forward AI research and community building that takes place in, or is focused on, the city of Atlanta. 2026 RESEARCH AREAS: Data Centers; AI Civics; AI Literacies; AI and Archives; Small Language Models; Capitalism, Anticapitalism, and Critique.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: GovAI Summer Fellowship 2027 (AI governance, London or Washington DC, GBP 14,000 for 3 months) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026, 23:59 GMT
Award: GBP 14,000 for 3 months plus travel support (UK Research Track figure; DC track has its own stipend). No application fee.

GovAI's Summer Fellowship brings early-career researchers and practitioners into AI governance for three months of full-time work on a research or applied project under the mentorship of a GovAI researcher.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Van Alen Institute: Re:Paris Prize, USD 35,000 travel research fellowship on design in Africa and its diaspora (US-based applicants) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Van Alen Institute
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026
Award: USD 35,000 travel fellowship; one US-based winner selected through this open call (two Africa-based winners were selected via the 2026 Pan-African Biennale).

The Re:Paris Prize, run by Van Alen Institute, funds research into how design plays a transformative role in Africa and its diaspora. Each winner receives a USD 35,000 travel fellowship for field research that requires international travel to connect with experts and opportunities.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest: Artist in Residence 2027 (Kentucky, USD 2,500 stipend) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest (Arts in Nature programme)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: USD 2,500 stipend, plus a furnished one-bedroom cabin (kitchen, bath, Wi-Fi), a studio near a 32-acre lake, staff support, and free or discounted classes and events. No application fee stated.

Annual residency in which artists live at Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest and create site-specific work inspired by total immersion in the natural environment. WHO: visual and mixed-media artists, including those working with sound and with performance that incorporates visual elements.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Knight-Wallace Journalism Fellowships 2027-28 (University of Michigan) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 85,000 stipend plus USD 5,000 relocation (figures from secondary listings; confirm on the official site).

An academic-year fellowship for mid-career journalists to pursue a study project at the University of Michigan, with seminars and programming at Wallace House. DEADLINES: international applicants 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm ET; US applicants 1 February 2027. No application fee stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sundance Institute: 2027 Graton Fellowship (USD 25,000 for California Native artists) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Sundance Institute, Indigenous Program
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 16:30 MST
Award: USD 25,000 cash grant to each of 2 fellows, plus a yearlong support programme. No application fee.

The Graton Fellowship, run by the Sundance Institute Indigenous Program, supports two Native storytellers from California tribes with an unrestricted cash grant and a year of creative and professional support from Sundance, including mentorship and access to Institute programmes.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IHS AI and the Workforce Research Grants (up to USD 20,000) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Institute for Humane Studies (IHS)
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: Up to USD 20,000 per award; larger awards possible for exceptional projects. Covers research costs (research assistants, datasets, LLM subscriptions, travel to present), not salary or overhead.

Research grants for academic scholars studying how AI is changing jobs, productivity and economic opportunity. Economics-leaning; IHS is a libertarian-leaning institute. Funds direct research costs only. No country restriction stated. Deadline 15 December 2026 (no time zone given).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Houston: Core Residency Program 2027-29 (USD 100,000 over 23 months, artists and critical writers) (closes 8 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Core Residency Program, Glassell School of Art, Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH)
Deadline: 8 Jan 2027
Award: USD 100,000 (USD 50,000 per year) plus a health and wellness stipend, private studio, and free or discounted Glassell School classes. Application fee USD 12.

Two-year residency for exceptional, highly motivated emerging artists and critical writers committed to developing a sustainable practice.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Knight Science Journalism Academic-Year Fellowship 2027-28 (MIT) (closes 9 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Knight Science Journalism Program at MIT
Deadline: 9 Jan 2027
Award: USD 87,500 stipend over 9.5 months, plus USD 5,000 for travel and housing, health insurance and a childcare subsidy. No application fee.

An academic-year fellowship at MIT for journalists covering science, health, technology or the environment, with seminars, MIT and Harvard courses and a self-directed study project.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: School for Advanced Research: Native Artist Fellowships 2027 (USD 15,000 plus Santa Fe residency) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
School for Advanced Research, Indian Arts Research Center
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027
Award: USD 15,000 stipend plus housing, studio space, a supplies allowance and travel. No application fee stated.

The Indian Arts Research Center at the School for Advanced Research offers three residential fellowships for Native American artists: the Eric and Barbara Dobkin Fellowship for Native women artists working in any media (including digital art and film/video), the Ronald and Susan Dubin Fellowship...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Vision Maker Media: Creative Shorts Fellowship (up to USD 25,000 for emerging Native filmmakers, rolling)
item.description:
Vision Maker Media
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Up to USD 25,000 production funding, plus USD 5,000 paid separately to the mentor. No application fee shown.

Vision Maker Media's Creative Shorts Fellowship funds emerging Native filmmakers to make a short film of 40 minutes or less (documentary, drama, experimental or animation), with guidelines inviting work that pushes the limits of art and technology.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Generator Residency (Kairos x Constellation, Winter 2027)
item.description: Kairos and Constellation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 8,500 per month stipend (some Embedded track residents employed at a roughly equivalent salary), plus travel to and from Berkeley. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Programmatic Open Call (public programs)
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 1,000 total per selected program, covering all costs including speaker and performer fees, travel, materials and equipment rental; proposals using external funding or smaller budgets welcome. The Museum sets ticket prices and keeps ticket revenue. No application fee.

item.title: NBER i3: Open Data Fellows Program 2027
item.description: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Innovation Information Initiative (i3) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 1,500 per fellow, at least five fellowships, plus travel reimbursement to present at the i3 Technical Working Group meeting in December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: Oregon Media Arts Fellowship 2026 (two USD 5,000 awards for Oregon media artists)
item.description: Portland Art Museum (PAM CUT) and Oregon Arts Commission · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of USD 5,000 each, no matching funds required; paid within two months of notification. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: Postdoctoral Fellow 2027, Crockett Lab (Princeton Psychology and University Center for Human Values)
item.description: Princeton University, Crockett Lab (Department of Psychology and University Center for Human Values) · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · USD 80,000 annual salary from a stable institutional funding source (not a cancellable grant).

item.title: Coding it Forward: Winter Fellowship 2027 (US civic tech placements)
item.description: Coding it Forward · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Paid full-time job placement: USD 20 per hour for applicants with a Bachelor's degree, USD 25 per hour for applicants pursuing or holding a graduate degree (Master's or PhD), at 40 hours per week for ten weeks (roughly USD 8,000 to 10,000 in total). Pay rates and work dates are non-negotiable. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic STEM Fellows Program 2027 (four-month AI-for-science fellowship, January to May 2027)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · USD 100,000 to 167,000 for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to USD 300,000 to 500,000 annualised), plus benefits; fellows are engaged through an employer of record on a fixed-term contract. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science and Safety Nodes RFP 2026 (Local Compute; Coordination and Accountability; AI-first Science)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Grants typically USD 30,000 to 100,000 (smaller awards for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance and Open Governance areas, larger for the rest; bigger amounts possible for the right project), usually paid as one lump sum, with up to 10 percent overhead. Optional office space in San Francisco or Berlin and access to private compute clusters. No application fee.

item.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
item.description: Processing Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend over the 8-month fellowship, plus open-source software mentorship, cohort collaboration, professional development and public presentation opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship 2027 (USD 38,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 38,000 for the six-month fellowship, covering the immersive cultural exchange in New York City. No application fee.

item.title: LMCC Manhattan Arts Grants: Creative Engagement 2027
item.description: Lower Manhattan Cultural Council (LMCC) · deadline 12 Nov 2026 · USD 1,000 to 20,000 per grant for public arts events in Manhattan between January and December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Adirondack Experience (ADKX) Artist-in-Residence 2027
item.description: Adirondack Experience, The Museum on Blue Mountain Lake (ADKX) · deadline 11 Dec 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend per one-month residency, plus USD 500 travel allowance, USD 250 Art Lab materials allowance, and free on-site housing with utilities, wi-fi and laundry included.

item.title: Loeb Fellowship 2027-28 at Harvard Graduate School of Design
item.description: Harvard Graduate School of Design · deadline 05 Jan 2027 · Stipend of USD 57,500 for the academic year (taxable), plus housing for fellows and their families coming from outside the Boston/Cambridge area through 30 June, and a travel grant covering approximately one economy round trip home per semester. No application fee.

item.title: The Center Fellowship for Justice-Impacted Artists (Center for Art & Advocacy, US)
item.description: The Center for Art & Advocacy · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 in unrestricted funds plus USD 10,000 in project development funds per fellow, awarded annually.

item.title: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans 2027 (US graduate study)
item.description: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 90,000 over two years (stipend and tuition support) toward graduate study; 30 fellowships awarded annually. No application fee.

item.title: Andrew Carnegie Fellows Program 2027
item.description: Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline 13 Nov 2026 · USD 200,000 over one to two years for research and writing toward a book or major study. NOTE: institutional nomination required; individuals cannot apply directly.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY NYC Residency, Spring 2027
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend per selected artist, plus mentorship and access to tools and technical expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: J. Anthony Lukas Work-in-Progress Awards 2027
item.description: Columbia Journalism School and the Nieman Foundation · deadline 03 Dec 2026 · Two awards of USD 25,000 each. No entry fee for the Work-in-Progress awards.

item.title: CURRENTS 2027 Art & Technology Festival: Call for Submissions (Santa Fe)
item.description: CURRENTS New Media / Parallel Studios · deadline 08 Dec 2026 · NO GUARANTEED CASH, listed as a deliberate exception to the desk's paid-only rule: selected artists may be eligible for travel, lodging and shipping support, decided case by case, and the festival may be able to supply needed equipment. International shipping support is explicitly uncertain due to cost. SUBMISSION FEE: USD 30 for a single work, USD 25 each for multiple works.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.
